news.analysis: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.
news.contents: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.title: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions

He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.
